answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the spiral is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the willow of a task receipt, and the island is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
